national_news.title: Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Train Flagged Off
bullets: Union Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw flagged off the 16-coach Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper train at Sir M. Visvesvaraya Terminal in Bengaluru.
The train connects India's IT hub with its financial capital, covering the distance in approximately 16 hours across key halts including Pune, Solapur, and Kalaburagi.
The Central Government approved the high-speed bullet train south corridor connecting Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Amravati, and Chennai, aiming to reduce Bengaluru-Chennai travel time to 73 minutes.

national_news.title: President Murmu Highlights Achievements of Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao Campaign
bullets: Addressing the 60th Haryana Day celebrations in Kurukshetra, President Droupadi Murmu emphasized the success of the nationwide Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao (BBBP) scheme launched in January 2015 from Panipat.
The Child Sex Ratio (CSR) at birth in the country improved from 871 girls per 1,000 boys in 2014 to approximately 915 by November 2025.
It was highlighted that Haryana contributes around 3.6% to India's GDP and has become the first state in India to procure 24 crops at Minimum Support Price (MSP).

national_news.title: SEBI Steps Up Tech Measures and AI Tool 'Sudarshan' to Combat Financial Scams
bullets: SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey announced key measures to protect investors from online fraud, including an AI-based tool named 'Sudarshan' to detect social media violations using a 5-stage checking process.
SEBI partnered with Google to introduce verified badges on the Play Store for official SEBI-related apps and expanded its WhatsApp investor awareness channel to 11 languages.
The regulator introduced the SCORES 2.0 portal for streamilined complaint redressal and promoted the 'SEBI Saarthi' App along with the SEBI Check verification facility.

national_news.title: Vice President Inaugurates National Organ Transplant Games 2026
bullets: Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan inaugurated the National Organ Transplant Games 2026 at Talkatora Stadium, New Delhi, highlighting that a single deceased organ donor can save up to eight lives.
A World Record was recognized by the World Book of Records after 570 transplant recipients and donors performed Tadasana together at the event.
The Vice President released the 'Zindagi Dobara' Calendar and felicitated Indian medal winners from the World Transplant Games 2025 held in Dresden, Germany.

national_news.title: Centre Sets Up High-Level Committee Chaired by Suresh N. Patel for Banking Reforms
bullets: The Union Ministry of Finance has constituted a High-Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat to suggest structural, regulatory, and legislative reforms in the banking sector.
The committee is chaired by former Central Vigilance Commissioner Suresh N. Patel and has been assigned a tenure of six months.
Other key members include RBI Deputy Governor Shirish Chandra Murmu, former Indian Bank MD Padmaja Chunduru, and former RBI Deputy Governor N. S. Vishwanathan.

national_news.title: President Droupadi Murmu Inaugurates Simhastha Kumbh Mela in Nashik
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu inaugurated the Simhastha Kumbh Mela in Nashik, becoming the first Indian President to hoist the flag at the event.
During the event, the President released the Kumbh Mela anthem 'Har Har Gange' composed by Ajay-Atul, an official website, and a special postage stamp.
The event emphasizes social harmony, cultural preservation, and long-term urban infrastructure transformation in Nashik and Trimbakeshwar.

national_news.title: Union Government Releases ₹1.09 Lakh Crore Tax Devolution to States
bullets: The Ministry of Finance released ₹1,09,019 crore as an advance instalment of tax devolution to state governments to help accelerate capital spending and welfare projects.
This marks the second additional tax devolution instalment disbursed by the Union Government in the current financial year.
Among all recipient states, Uttar Pradesh received the highest allocation of ₹19,208 crore, followed by Bihar at ₹10,845 crore.

national_news.title: India's First Indigenous Bullet Train 'B28' Manufactured at BEML Bengaluru
bullets: India's first indigenous high-speed bullet train set, named 'B28', is being built at BEML's Bengaluru workshop in collaboration with the Integral Coach Factory (ICF).
The train is designed for a top speed of 350 km/h with a operational speed of 320 km/h, intended for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail corridor.
The B28 coach successfully passed the mandatory 'squeeze test', verifying its structural capability to withstand aerodynamic vacuum pressure at high speeds.

national_news.title: EPFO Celebrates 74th Foundation Day with ₹32 Lakh Crore Corpus
bullets: The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) commemorated its 74th Foundation Day at the Dr. Ambedkar International Centre, New Delhi.
Union Minister for Labour & Employment Mansukh Mandaviya stated that EPFO's corpus has reached ₹32 lakh crore, supported by contributions from over 8 crore active members.
The event emphasized digital governance upgrades such as CITES 2.01 and expanding social security frameworks to unorganized sector workers.

national_news.title: PM Inaugurates 31 Projects at Ekta Nagar Ahead of Rashtriya Ekta Diwas
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated and laid the foundation stones for 31 tourism and infrastructure projects worth over ₹426 crore at Ekta Nagar in Gujarat.
Key inaugurated attractions include a 12-acre artificial Rain Forest featuring a circular glass skywalk, Vaman Vriksha Vatika, an IRCTC hotel, and the Ekta Cruise.
The visit was conducted as part of the 'Rashtriya Ekta Diwas' celebrations commemorating the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.

national_news.title: EAM Advocates Diplomacy and Maritime Security at G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar addressed the first plenary session of the G20 Foreign Ministers’ Meeting in Atlanta, USA, stressing diplomacy over military solutions to global conflicts.

EAM emphasized adherence to the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) to protect freedom of navigation and civilian shipping, noting the disproportionate impact of supply chain disruptions on the Global South.
On the sidelines of the G20 meeting, India also engaged in the QUAD Foreign Ministers' Meeting alongside representatives from the US, Japan, and Australia.

national_news.title: ISRO Successfully Launches NVS-03 Navigation Satellite via GSLV-F18
bullets: ISRO successfully launched the 2,232 kg NVS-03 satellite into Geosynchronous Transfer Orbit using the GSLV-F18 rocket from Sriharikota, marking the 20th flight of the GSLV.
NVS-03 is the third satellite in the second-generation NavIC constellation, equipped with an indigenous atomic clock and introducing the L1 frequency band alongside existing L5 and S bands.
The mission strengthens India's independent positioning and timing system (NavIC), which provides coverage across India and up to 1,500 km beyond its borders.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Makhana Exports Reach 7,265 Tonnes in FY 2025-26
bullets: Bihar's makhana (fox nut) exports reached 7,264.89 tonnes in FY 2025-26, with the US, Canada, and UAE accounting for approximately 77% of total shipments.
Bihar accounts for 85% to 90% of India's makhana production, with total cultivation covering 35,224 hectares across Mithilanchal, Seemanchal, and Kosi regions.
High-yielding varieties like Sabour Makhana-1 yield 32–35 quintals per hectare with a 55–60% pop recovery rate, with Katihar and Purnea emerging as leading producing districts.

bihar_news.title: TEA Global Experience Index Ranks Palace Museum as World's Most Visited
bullets: The Themed Entertainment Association (TEA) published the 2025 Global Experience Index, recording 161.4 million total visits across the world's top 20 museums in 2025, a 5.4% increase from 2024.
China's Palace Museum (Forbidden City) in Beijing ranked as the most visited museum globally with 19 million visitors, followed by the Summer Palace (17.38 million).
France's Louvre Museum ranked 4th globally with 9.05 million visitors, while the Vatican Museums and UK's Natural History Museum also featured in the top 10 list.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Announces Tallest Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Statue in Patna
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced the state government's decision to install Bihar's tallest statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel in Patna.
The announcement was made during a Rashtriya Ekta Diwas event at Bapu Sabhagar in Patna to honour Patel's legacy.
The proposed monument will be the largest statue among all eminent personalities established in the state, commemorating Sardar Patel's role in integrating over 560 princely states into India.
